intro: dssconfessions is also where I practice being more creative. I'm revamping my older projects to push myself past 'it works' and into 'it feels good': new layouts, new colors, new ideas. Each redesign teaches me something, so I keep the older versions here. This is the journey so far.
disclaimer: Screenshots use placeholder text. Real confessions are never shown here.

versions.name: Black & White Brutalist
versions.summary: Stark high-contrast neo-brutalist aesthetic with pure monochrome surfaces, heavy ink borders, and an infinite marquee ribbon.
learned: What worked: Bold visual punch, distinctive handwriting accent font pairing (Caveat and Reenie Beanie), and raw student-built character.
What needed improvement: Gray metadata had low contrast (~2.5:1), handwriting text truncated on cards made confessions hard to read, and the lack of warm color felt stark.

versions.name: Sunny Mixtape
versions.summary: Light, warm, and playful neo-brutalist theme featuring a gentle pastel wash background, soft navy ink, electric blue primary accents, modular pinboard cards, and a floating Mixtape Scrubber.
learned: What worked: Welcoming community feel that feels optimistic rather than gloomy, strict WCAG AA contrast on every pastel card, and interactive touches like the Mixtape Scrubber and unlimited Poke button.
What we're keeping: Live-text handwriting wordmark, tactile 2px ink borders, solid offset drop shadows, and zero-tracking privacy promise.
